description: HEADLINE cross-binding conformance: conservative regridding END-TO-END DECLARATIVE THROUGH THE CANDIDATE-GATED BROAD PHASE -- grid spec (tgt_x0/tgt_y0 = 0, tgt_dx/tgt_dy = 1.5, GX = GY = 2 bound at the regridding/cartesian_cell_rings.esm import edge) -> constructed cell rings (cartesian_cell_rings_poly) -> spatial-overlap broad phase (conservative_overlap_*_gated carry join.overlap{src_env:[src_poly], tgt_env:[tgt_poly]}; the engine builds the candidate set from the cell-ring bounding boxes at build time) -> gated narrow phase / assembly / apply (manifold 'planar') -> regrid, with NO out-of-document precomputation. This is the gated sibling of cartesian_rings_regrid_3x3_to_2x2 (dense narrow phase). The case builds through load -> flatten -> build_evaluator(FlattenedSystem) (what run_pde_tests / simulate use), running template expansion and the geometry-setup broad+narrow phase. On this compact tiling every cell's bounding box lies in [0,3]x[0,3], the candidate set is the full 9x4 cross product, and the join gate is exercised end-to-end while provably admitting every genuine overlap (the constructed centers cartesian_cell_rings_lon/_lat are kept as an independent construction check in the affine_formula gate). THREE GATES: affine_formula (constructed rings/centers match the inline oracle EXACTLY, abs 0.0), exact_invariants (partition-of-unity + conservation, CONFORMANCE_SPEC 5.8.3), and gated_equals_dense (the gated A_ij/A_j/W_ij are VALUE-IDENTICAL to the dense-path templates on the same constructed rings, abs 0.0). The golden per-pair weights (official Julia runner, scripts/regenerate-goldens.sh; here the GATED matrices) reproduce the dense exemplar conservative_overlap_3x3_to_2x2's exact rationals (A_ij corner 1.0 / edge 0.5 / center 0.25 deg^2, A_j = 2.25, W = 4/9 / 2/9 / 1/9, F_tgt = [7/3, 11/3, 19/3, 23/3], mass 45).

scope_excluded.go: rewrite-only port; no aggregate lowering / simulator
scope_excluded.typescript: rewrite-only port; no aggregate lowering / simulator

tolerances._doc: Identical to conservative_overlap_gated_3x3_to_2x2 and the dense exemplar (same geometry after construction, same 5.8 contract): sliver floor atol = area_atol_factor * characteristic_length^2; partition-of-unity exact by construction; conservation exact because the constructed target tiles the source domain. The gated-vs-dense value identity and the affine construction are gated in-fixture at abs 0.0 (see tests).
